title: I made a cozy voxel department-store clicker – One More Shopping
author: Illustrious_Ad_6443
selftext:
Grow a tiny shop into a five-department store: serve shoppers, upgrade products, pick relics and survive the Sale Rush. Every run makes the next one stronger.  
Free in the browser and on mobile: [https://itsmedadko.itch.io/one-more-shopping](https://itsmedadko.itch.io/one-more-shopping)  
Full transparency: I'm not a programmer and made this with the help of AI. It's what let me turn my idea into a real game. Feedback very welcome!

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/Illustrious_Ad_6443 could you add more about how AI fit into your development process? Just mentioning that AI was used doesn't cut it. Under Rule 4, promotional posts need to contribute something by discussing how the game was actually made. Otherwise the sub gets buried in ads. If there's no update, this post may be removed.

replies.author: Illustrious_Ad_6443
replies.body:
I'm not a programmer, so Claude (Anthropic's AI) wrote all the code. The game is a single HTML file using three.js, which is why it runs in the browser and on mobile.  
My part was the idea, the design and a lot of playtesting. The workflow was a loop: describe a feature, play it, give specific feedback ("the first 5 minutes feel slow", "the layout blocks shoppers at the entrance"), repeat.
